transcript.answer: The mapping is `ESCALATION_BY_KIND` in `apps/api/src/tools/defineTmsTool.ts`. It is a `Record<TmsErrorKind, EscalationTrigger | null>`, so a kind with no row fails `npm run typecheck`. Two TMS error kinds escalate: `unavailable` (5xx) maps to `tms_unavailable`, and `timeout` maps to `tms_timeout`. A customer-scope data-integrity conflict on the order path also escalates, with the trigger `customer_scope_conflict`. That one is not a TMS error kind. The other kinds map to null and do not escalate: `not_found` (404), `rate_limited`, `network`, `invalid_response`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden` and `unexpected`. They still render a card, just without an escalation marker. A `tms_unavailable` escalation can also be recorded together with `tool_budget_exhausted` when the tool budget runs out in the same turn. I read the mapping's location and the kind-to-trigger table from the spec text. I did not open the source file itself.
